WITH BASE AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
            PARTITION BY FXD_CRNCY_CODE, VAR_CRNCY_CODE, RATECODE, RTLIST_DATE
            ORDER BY RTLIST_NUM DESC
        ) AS RN,
        RTLIST_DATE,
        RTLIST_NUM,
        FXD_CRNCY_CODE,
        VAR_CRNCY_CODE,
        RATECODE,
        FXD_CRNCY_UNITS,
        VAR_CRNCY_UNITS
    FROM BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE
),
 
EXISTING AS (
    SELECT
        BASE.FXD_CRNCY_CODE AS lkupFromCurrency,
        BASE.VAR_CRNCY_CODE AS lkuptoCurrency,
        'BSP' AS lkupFXSource,
        CASE
            WHEN FXD_CRNCY_CODE IS NOT NULL AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'USD' AND RATECODE = 'BSP'
                THEN FORMAT(BASE.VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, '0.000000')
            WHEN FXD_CRNCY_CODE IS NOT NULL AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'BSP'
                THEN FORMAT(BASE.VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, '0.0000')
            WHEN FXD_CRNCY_CODE = 'USD' AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'REV'
                THEN FORMAT(BASE.VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, '0.0000')
            WHEN FXD_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'USD' AND RATECODE = 'REV'
                THEN FORMAT(1 / BASE.VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, '0.000000')
        END AS rate,
        BASE.RTLIST_DATE AS fxRateDate
    FROM BASE
    WHERE RN = 1
      AND (
            (FXD_CRNCY_CODE IS NOT NULL AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'USD' AND RATECODE = 'BSP')
         OR (FXD_CRNCY_CODE IS NOT NULL AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'BSP')
         OR (FXD_CRNCY_CODE = 'USD' AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'REV')
         OR (FXD_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'USD' AND RATECODE = 'REV')
      )
      AND NOT (FXD_CRNCY_CODE = 'USD' AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'BSP')
      AND NOT (FXD_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'USD' AND RATECODE = 'BSP')
),
 
DATES AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT RTLIST_DATE
    FROM BASE
),
 
USD_PHP AS (
    SELECT
        RTLIST_DATE,
        VAR_CRNCY_UNITS AS usd_to_php
    FROM BASE
    WHERE FXD_CRNCY_CODE = 'USD'
      AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP'
      AND RATECODE = 'REV'
      AND RN = 1
),

BASE2 AS (
SELECT * FROM EXISTING
 
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'PHP' AS lkupFromCurrency,
    'PHP' AS lkuptoCurrency,
    'BSP' AS lkupFXSource,
    '1.0000' AS rate,
    d.RTLIST_DATE AS fxRateDate
FROM DATES d
 
UNION ALL
 
SELECT
    'PHP' AS lkupFromCurrency,
    'USD' AS lkuptoCurrency,
    'BSP' AS lkupFXSource,
    FORMAT(1 / u.usd_to_php, '0.000000') AS rate,
    d.RTLIST_DATE AS fxRateDate
FROM DATES d
JOIN USD_PHP u
    ON d.RTLIST_DATE = u.RTLIST_DATE
)

SELECT
    *,
    CASE 
        WHEN lkupFromCurrency IN ('USD', 'JPY', 'GBP', 'HKD', 'CHF', 'CAD', 'SGD', 'AUD', 'BHD', 'KWD', 'SAR', 'BND', 'IDR', 'THB', 'AED', 'EUR', 'KRW', 'CNY') THEN 'yes'
        WHEN lkupFromCurrency IN ('ARS', 'BRL', 'DKK', 'INR', 'MYR', 'MXN', 'NZD', 'NOK', 'PKR', 'ZAR', 'SEK', 'SYP', 'TWD', 'VES', 'VEB') THEN 'no'
        ELSE 'na'
    END AS lkupIsConvertibleCurrency,
    NULL AS custom1,
    NULL AS custom2,
    NULL AS custom3
FROM BASE2
ORDER BY fxRateDate, lkuptoCurrency, lkupFromCurrency;
